 c={'name':name,'argv':args,'status':'running'};proof['commands'].append(c);save();start=time.monotonic();log=O/(name+'.log')
 try:H['run'](args,cwd=cwd,timeout=timeout,limit=24*1024**2,env=env,log_path=log);c.update(status='passed',exit=0);print(name+': passed',flush=True)
 finally:
  c['seconds']=time.monotonic()-start

  save()
